annotations.title: Heat loss and heat source size

description: Works out the heat loss of each room (fabric U x A x delta T plus ventilation 0.33 x air changes x volume x delta T) and the total, then sizes a combi, system or regular boiler, or a heat pump, to the nearest common size. Combi sizing also checks the hot water load (flow x temperature rise). Give each room's type, size and its walls, windows, roof and floor with U values, or construction presets for indicative values. Returns per-room losses with every element's working, the total, the size, `status` (indicative when presets were used), `must_check` and sources. Typical call: {"heat_source":"heat_pump","outside_design_temp_c":-3,"rooms":[{"name":"Lounge","type":"living","floor_area_m2":20,"elements":[{"type":"wall","area_m2":7.8,"construction":"cavity_wall_unfilled"},{"type":"window","area_m2":1.8,"construction":"double_glazed_old"}]}]}.

cylinder_litres.description: System or regular boiler: cylinder size. Default 150.

hot_water_flow_l_min.description: Combi: wanted hot water flow. Default 12.

margin_percent.description: Added to the heating load. Default 10 for boilers, 0 for heat pumps.

adjacent.description: What is on the other side. Defaults to outside. neighbour = attached home (10 C); unheated = garage or loft space (halfway temperature); heated = another room (give adjacent_temp_c).

construction.description: Indicative U value preset when the real one is not known.

u_value.description: U value in W/m2K if known. Otherwise give construction.

type.description: Sets the default temperature and air changes.

trade.description: Optional. The plumber or heating engineer's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1, the same shape as Spark Pack and Nero Work). Used to prefill records and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Flow Pack.

categories.description: Trades offered, using Nero Work trade names. Defaults to ["plumber", "heating"].

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Northside Plumbing & Heating".

licence_body.description: Registration scheme. For gas work use gas_safe with the business's Gas Safe registration number.

licence_number.description: Scheme registration number (Gas Safe registration numbers are usually 6 or 7 digits).
